en: Oh...? I don't believe I've seen you before.
Good day! A fine morning, isn't it, er...
I've only just come to London.
Ah, I see. Well, this is a fine city.
There's some nasty crime, but it's convenient.
My name is Bradford.
I work at the marriage bureau.
I help people find that special someone.
Do drop by sometime, if you like. Good day.
Mornings are always so busy, aren't they?
Well, if it isn't
And how are you today?
Still on your own, by the look of it.
Do come to the bureau any time.
I'll be glad to help.
Well, well,
Tell me, have you become interested
in marriage at last?
As before, I have no interest in it.
Do you really think so?
It's the people we meet who shape our lives.
And the partings too, of course...
My door is always open to you.
Oh, I don't believe I've seen you around here.
Perhaps I should say "pleased to meet you"?
Yes, I suppose so.
But why did you speak to me?
You looked rather downcast, you see.
I'm afraid I meddled where I wasn't wanted.
Do forgive me. I'm Bradford.
I give advice on matters of marriage.
If you're interested, I'm by the job agency...
Kind of you to offer, but
I'm afraid I'm more at ease on my own.
I see. Well, I'm glad we had this chat.
My door is always open. Good night.
You're always welcome, you know.
You seem to be busy every day.
All work will wear you out, you know?
We do keep meeting. It must be fate.
And how is your work going?
I'm sure we'll meet again.
And do feel free to drop by the bureau.
I'm Bradford.
I'm here to help you find love and happiness.
Pardon me, but what is this place...?
Oh my, you didn't know?
It's the marriage bureau, by the job agency.
It seems you've come in by mistake.
Ah, er... My apologies.
I don't know my way around yet.
I see. Please, think nothing of it.
But do remember this place.
I'm sure it will serve you well one day.
...Oh? Have we met before?
Yes, we've met before.
Your name was Bradford, was it not?
Oh, you remembered my name!
Nothing could please me more. Thank you.
Now, what brings you here today?
<Tell me about the city>
<Tell me about the bureau>
This city is a center of industry and culture.
Though nasty crimes and dark rumors never end.
This place? The job agency is next door.
note: No used_in; probably the first line of the bureau branch (msg 58474), lost by the decoder after the branch op.

en: The marriage bureau is half a hobby of mine.
Hobby or not, I give serious advice.
Oh? Here for some advice?
Welcome!
Oh, it's you. Here for some advice?
Any troubles in matters of love, ask away.
Hello. So you've come again.
Are you really not interested in marriage?
<Not in the least>
<Well, someday>
I see. You're a rare one.
Do you think marriage is the grave of life?
You're quite wrong there.
"Someday," you say?
You should seize your chance while you can.
